returned_by_app_function.answer: In the Acme Services Agreement, the Supplier's total liability is capped at the fees paid in the preceding 12 months. Additionally, neither party is liable for indirect loss.

citations.label: Limitation of Liability Cap
citations.quote: The Supplier's total liability under this Agreement shall not exceed the fees paid in the preceding 12 months.

citations.label: Exclusion of Indirect Loss
citations.quote: Neither party is liable for indirect loss.

returned_by_app_function.limitations: The cap is expressed as a rolling 12-month fee figure rather than a fixed monetary amount; the exact dollar value of the cap will depend on fees actually paid in the relevant period.
